items.text: Hey Mighty Fighters,
We've pushed a hotfix and quality-of-life update that addresses the following issues:
Fixed memory leak causing occasional crashes on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch
Fixed potential soft-lock when quickly navigating from Quick Play to Lobby
Partial workaround for Windows 7 users unable to boot game. Game now boots and is playable, but Arcade Mode videos don't play. We're working on the fix for that.
Killbot no longer goes invisible when canceling out of teleport.
Originelle no longer has infinite hitbox when canceling out of Hype Attack.
Earl no longer leaves ghost presents when re-spawning or canceling at various intervals.
Arcade Free-For-Alls no longer favour ToeJam & Earl and Yooka-Laylee.
Fix for players occasionally getting stuck in throws (Zen Handbag glitch).
Fix for ToeJam & Earl Color 1 having incorrect win pose assets.
Fix for Tutorial referring to Heckbane when it should refer to Strikefist.
Fix for "slo-mo" glitch when a Hype Attack is activated during a kill-cam.
Yooka-Laylee no longer stay invisible when finishing a match with Camoflage activated.
Yooka-Laylee no longer has duplicate Color name on Fighter Select screen.
ToeJam & Earl: Earl now has a limit of 3 presents at a time.
Added timeouts to Fighter and Stage Selects when playing online to prevent griefing.
Optimized loading of assets
Hi Mighty Fighters,
Small patch update today to add in support for impending Cross-Play, user reporting, and general bug-fixes and optimizations.
No new balancing, mechanics or content... yet.
-Komi Games
Hello Mighty Fighters!
Just a small update as we lead up to our full launch. Notes are below.
Projectile Priority: Projectiles now have individual Power Level values that determine what happens in a clash.
Cross-Play: Systems have been put in place in preparation for cross-play with other consoles.
Fix for online matches with 3+ players where the match would not end until timeout.
General: Fix for Achievements erroneously unlocking on Steam
General: Players can no longer accidentally double-jump when pressing jump at the moment of falling.
Arcade Mode: Ending videos can now be skipped
Visual: Fix for Shadow Originelle occasionally disappearing in Dark Form.
Visual: Fix for Hyperion occasionally disappearing during win screen.
Visual: Various visual fixes across characters and stages.
Training Stage: Adjusted camera collision on Training Stage to make players more visible.
Killbot Factory: Adjusted collision to prevent characters from going offscreen in the corner.
Lobbies: added more lobby names.
Hyperion is now invulnerable during his Hype Attack.
LEXE: Tri-Core Shot hitstun frames increased from 12 to 30
Tunestone: Skull Shot hitstun frames increased from 16 to 30
ToeJam: Significant damage boost across the board
ToeJam & Earl: Increased size of swap attack hitbox and sped up swap speed
ToeJam & Earl: Increased size and duration of Hype Attack hitbox
Hello Mighty Fighters!

We've pushed a small patch for European language users. This update fixes a bug that was causing incorrect text display on menus when the system's language was set to French, Italian, German or Spanish.
Menus and content should now display properly. The game is still English-only, but localizations will be coming when we leave Early Access.
Hello Mighty Fighters!
We have pushed our fourth patch for Early Access. This one adds a few small features, bug fixes, and a whole bunch of quality-of-life balance changes and updates. Please see patch notes below:
Training: Added quick reset by pressing Back (Xbox 360), Change View (Xbox One), Touchpad (DualShock 4), and C (keyboards)
Tutorial: Current button mappings are now displayed in Tutorial UI
Tunestone: Hype Attack no longer prematurely collides with walls
LEXE: changed Spin Strike hitstun from 18 frames to 20 frames
Strikefist: Hype Attack, Prime Finisher, now causes knockback on final hit
Stingray: greatly reduced startup frames on Detonate in air and on ground
Stingray: reduced startup frames on Vengeance Mine by 10
Mighty Fight Arena: reduced scale of arena by 25%
Training Stage: reduced scale of arena by 25%
Mighty Fight Arena: changed angle of camera to reduce obscurance
General: increased speed of camera movement in larger stages
General: added new transition effect between screens
UI: added a shine effect to Hype bar to better signify when a bar is available for use
Crash: fix for occasional soft-lock during Arcade Mode that would occur before Rival Fights
Player Select: fixed Random Select functionality
Training Mode / Tutorial: adjusted jump height of Training Dummy
Control Mapping: fixed certain button mappings not displaying correctly
Visual: Heckbane no longer respawns with Swole visual effect after dying with the Swole state
Lobbies: lobbies no longer default to Private on creation
Toejam & Earl currently do not have Arcade Mode content. That will be available for full launch.
Occasionally during a networked match, landing a Hype Attack may not play the cutscene for one opponent. The damage is still dealt, however.
Hello Mighty Fighters!
We have pushed our second patch for Early Access. This one adds many new gameplay features, a new Intermediate tutorial, and plenty of balancing. Please see patch notes below:
Very rarely the game can will crash upon completion of an Arcade story.
Very rarely the game will hang during Arcade Mode after intro dialogue.
Feature: Intermediate tutorial has been added to the main menu.
Mechanic: Wall jumping has been added to the game and explained in Intermediate tutorial.
Improved: Dash can now be jump-cancelled.
Improved: [Training Stage] Adjusted camera angle on Training Stage
Improved: [The L.A.B.] Adjusted camera angle on The L.A.B. stage.
Fixed: Fixed being unable to close Arcade Menu with cancel button.
Fixed: Camera no longer escapes collision in Training Stage.
Fixed: Camera no longer escapes collision in Tunestone's Tavern.
Fixed: Camera no longer escapes collision in The L.A.B.
Fixed: LEXE may no longer hold Infection Injection past its maximum charge.
Fixed: Fix for Shadow LEXE Costume not unlocking.
Fixed: Fix for rare issue where Heckbane would rotate during a jab.
Fixed: Fix for roll occasionally not going full distance.
Balance: Adjusted hitstun deteriotation percentages to allow for slightly longer ground combos.
Balance: Extended roll duration to 23 frames from 20. Invuln period decreased to 13 frames from 15. Distance increased to 3.5 from 3.
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on Buy Buy Buy from 53 to 40
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on Sell Sell Sell from 54 to 40
Balance: Greed Wave startup reduced from 21 to 14. Recovery frames reduced from 28 to 18.
Balance: Reduced Murder & Acquisition Install recovery frames from 106 to 70
Balance: Reduced Murder & Acquisition Activation startup frames from 25 to 11.
Balance: Dash distance increased from 6 to 7 units.
Balance: Added 2 frames of jump squat at beginning of jump.
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on launcher from 20 to 10
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on third hit of "One, Two, Three" from 10 to 6
Balance: Reduced startup frames on "Power Bomb" from 10 to 6
Balance: Reduced lifetime of Taserball Tracker from 180 frames to 60.: Once again, we thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates as the game develops!
Hello Mighty Fighters!
We have pushed our first major patch for Early Access. This one adds many new gameplay features, outlined below, as well as fully voiced cutscenes for Arcade Mode!
Currently LEXE and Heckbane are the only characters with Spot Dodge animations. Every other character rolls in place.
Very rarely Heckbane will rotate during a jab, offsetting his hitbox.
Occasionally the camera can get caught behind the collision wall in the Training Stage.
Very rarely the game can will crash upon completion of an Arcade story.
Very rarely the game will hang during Arcade Mode after intro dialogue.
Feature: Arcade Mode now has fully voiced story intros and outros for each characters.
Feature: Players can now unlock character Shadow costumes by beating Arcade Mode.
Feature: You can now visualize player debug data, including current Auto Target Angle from Training Menu.

Mechanic: New mechanic: Universal Dash. Pressing Breaker when Idle or Moving will trigger a dash towards the targeted opponent. Dashes may be cancelled into attacks,: but not breakers or rolls. Dashing away from a target is significantly slower.
Mechanic: Wall bounces are now limited to 3 in a combo before a hard reset occurs.
Mechanic: Launchers are now limited to 3 in a combo before a hard reset occurs.
Mechanic: Rolls now move a fixed distance in a held direction, rather than allowing for free movement.
Mechanic: Spot-Dodges can now be performed by rolling without a held direction.
Mechanic: Hitstun deterioriation is now in effect. Hitstun deteriorates based on the number of hits in a combo.
Mechanic: Players can no longer attack or jump out of a Roll. Players can still jump and attack out of a Spot Dodge.
Fixed: Music tracks have been updated to final masters for most characters.
Fixed: Fixed bug where some AI would occasionally become unresponsive.
Fixed: Projectiles no longer are destroyed when colliding with a player during I-Frames
Fixed: Fixed bug where player indicator numbers would disappear after a grab cutscene.
Fixed: Directional input no longer partially turns character. Tapping a direction will make the character immediately face that direction.
Fixed: Single-frame short-hopping into an attack from a jump results in the Ground attack coming out, rather than eating the input.
Fixed: Fixed bug where characters would retain glow on respawn after kills during Super Armor or Hype Attacks.
Improved: AI intelligence has been improved across the board.
Improved: I-Frames are now visualized by a yellow flash.
Improved: Basic Tutorial has been updated to include the Dash mechanic and to clarify the functionality of Rolls and Spot Dodges.
Balance: Killbot's Overcharge no longer clears built-up charges.
Balance: Damage scaling now caps at 40% rather than 10%.
Balance: Reduced ground bounce limit in combos to 3 rather than 4
Balance: Reduced Hype generation when Taking Damage from 100 to 50
Balance: Reduced Hype generation when Dealing Damage from 50 to 40
Balance: Roll duration has been reduced from 30 to 20 frames.
Balance: Modified hitstun on ground projectile.
Balance: Removed knockdown property from air projectile, added 30 frames of hitstun.
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on both ground projectiles.
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on ground projectile. Added wall bounce to knockback.
Balance: Hype Attack damage increased from 300 to 450 (unscaled)
Balance: Reduced recovery frames on Tornado Upper
Balance: Replaced Aerial Legislative Flip with new dive kick, Red Tape.
Balance: Increased Crate Toss damage to 100.
Balance: Increased Filibuster Kicks damage to 30 per hit from 20 (180 unscaled total).
Balance: Added in 2 frame window when jumping before an attack can be performed. This is to eliminate extreme short hops.
Balance: Increased damage on Hype Attack to 550 (unscaled)
Balance: Decreased damage on Hype Attack to 780 (unscaled) to account for new scaling values.
Balance: Decreased damage on Hype Attack to account for new scaling values.
Balance: Overall, LEXE's size has been increased 15% to prevent "Oddjob Syndrome" with her hitboxes.
Balance: Form changes now cause wallbounce and are designated as Launchers.
Balance: Hitstun on Spin Kick Strike has been increased to prevent the bread & butter combo from dropping.
Balance: Hype Attack initial hits now cause increased hitstun to prevent a reset during the Hype Attack.
Balance: Decreased Hype Attack startup frames from 36 to 25 to allow for comboing from Destructive Drop
Balance: Reduced default Auto Target Angle to 65 degrees from 85.
Balance Dramatically reduced Auto Target Angle on projectile attacks. Can now be specified per-attack.: Once again, we thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates as the game develops!
Hello Mighty Fighters!
We have pushed a small patch that addresses the following issues:
Fixed: Buttons defaulting to keyboard even if a joystick is present
Fixed: Prevent a player from backing out of character select during a networked game, causing the game to desync.
Fixed: Button mapping shortcut for Hype Factor now works.
Fixed: Hype Factor can now be activated during Hitstun or Knockback like a Breaker.
Fixed: Occasional network issues when attempting to start a lobby game after returning to the lobby from a previous game
Fixed: Client not recognizing that host is charging a charge attack (i.e. Tunestone's "Mosh Pit")

Added: Players can now quit from the Main Menu by hitting Escape / Back.: Stay tuned for more updates over the following weeks. If you have any questions, please feel free to message us in our Discord or leave a comment here.
